title: Team Lead
description:
**About Company**

HiLITE Properties, a key division of HiLITE Group, brings “The Finer Side of Life” to the real estate sector in Kerala. Established in 2021, the company has rapidly grown into one of the region’s notable real estate developers. With landmark projects such as HiLITE Mall Thrissur and HiLITE Boulevard, HiLITE Properties has built a strong reputation for quality and innovation. The team focuses on creating distinctive commercial and residential spaces that elevate community living and business experiences. Professionals joining HiLITE Properties can expect a dynamic environment with opportunities to contribute to high-visibility projects.

**Role Description**
:

The Team Lead is a full-time, on-site role based in Thrissur. This role is responsible for leading and managing the sales team, setting sales targets, and monitoring performance against goals. Day-to-day responsibilities include identifying and nurturing leads conducting property presentations and site visits, negotiating and closing sales, and maintaining strong relationships with prospective and existing customers and collaborates with marketing and project teams to develop sales strategies, supports promotional activities, and ensures timely reporting and documentation. The role also involves market analysis, competitor tracking, and continuous improvement of sales processes to achieve revenue and growth objectives.

**Requirements :**

\* Proven experience in sales management, preferably in real estate or related industries with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets.

• Strong leadership and team management skills including the ability to coach, motivate, and develop a sales team.

• Effective communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills for engaging with diverse customers and stakeholders.

• Ability to perform market research, analyze sales data, and use CRM or sales management tools to drive decisions.

• Solid customer service orientation and relationship-building abilities to support long-term client engagement.Organizational and time-management skills to handle multiple inquiries, follow-ups, and documentation accurately.

• Familiarity with real estate regulations, property documentation, and local market dynamics in Kozhikode and Kerala is an advantage.

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Management, or a related field; equivalent professional experience may be considered,

• Willingness to work on-site, including weekends or extended hours when required for customer visits and events.

Interested candidates can share their updated CV or

apply directly

title: Google ads expert
description:
**Company Description** 
 myG is South India’s most trusted digital retail brand, operating over 140 stores across Kerala. The company serves a diverse customer base with a wide range of gadgets including smartphones, laptops, tablets, cameras, and home appliances. With more than one crore satisfied customers, myG focuses on delivering reliable products and services through both its regular stores and the myG Future store concept. The brand is expanding its network with a clear vision to become the world’s largest gadget network, creating opportunities for professionals to grow alongside a rapidly scaling retail organization.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Google Ads Expert at myG will manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns to drive traffic, conversions, and in\-store visits across Kerala locations. This full\-time, on\-site role based in calicut, Kerala, involves planning and executing performance marketing strategies, conducting keyword and audience research, and creating compelling ad copy and extensions aligned with brand guidelines. The role includes monitoring campaign performance, analyzing data, and implementing bid and budget adjustments to achieve target ROAS and CPA. The Google Ads Expert will collaborate with marketing, sales, and e\-commerce teams to align campaigns with promotional calendars, product launches, and local store initiatives. Day\-to\-day responsibilities also include A/B testing ads and landing pages, maintaining accurate tracking, preparing performance reports, and recommending continuous improvements.
   

  

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong expertise in Google Ads campaign management, including Search, Display, and YouTube, with proven experience in performance optimization.
* Skills in keyword research, audience targeting, and competitive analysis to support effective and data\-driven campaign strategies.
* Ability to create clear, persuasive ad copy and coordinate with creative teams on visuals and landing pages for better conversion rates.
* Proficiency in using Google Analytics and related tools to track, measure, and report campaign performance and user behavior.
* Experience managing budgets, bids, and pacing to meet defined marketing goals while maximizing ROI.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the capacity to interpret data and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross\-functional teams in a fast\-paced retail environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics, or a related field; relevant certifications such as Google Ads and Google Analytics are highly beneficial.
* Experience in retail, e\-commerce, or consumer electronics marketing is an added advantage.

title: Business Manager – North Kerala (Fans & Home Appliances)
description:
**Company:** 
 Khaitan India Ltd.
 



**Location:** 
 North Kerala
 



**Industry:** 
 Ceiling Fans, Home Appliances (SDA) \& Consumer Durables
 



**Experience Required:** 
 12 to 15 Years
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 Khaitan India Ltd. is looking for an experienced, high\-impact
 **Business Manager** 
 to spearhead commercial operations, revenue generation, and market expansion across
 **North Kerala** 
 (Kozhikode, Kannur, Malappuram, Kasaragod, and Wayanad).
 



 The ideal candidate will bring deep channel expertise in fans and home appliances, backed by established distributor connections across the Malabar region. The incumbent will be responsible for driving primary and secondary sales targets, expanding dealer penetration, managing commercial hygiene, and leading a productive field sales force.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Revenue \& Sales Target Delivery:** 
 Formulate and execute regional sales plans to consistently achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual primary and secondary targets (volume and value) for fans and home appliances.
* **Distribution \& Channel Expansion:** 
 Identify, onboard, and manage high\-performing distributors, super\-stockists, and direct retail dealers across key towns in North Kerala.
* **Team Leadership \& Beat Governance:** 
 Direct, mentor, and monitor Area Sales Managers (ASMs), Territory Executives, and field officers to maintain high retail beat coverage and sales productivity.
* **Commercial \& Credit Discipline:** 
 Oversee distributor billing cycles, enforce credit policies, minimize outstanding dues, and protect distributor ROI in compliance with company commercial guidelines.
* **Trade Schemes \& Market Visibility:** 
 Implement competitive dealer incentive schemes, festive promotions (Onam, Vishu, etc.), retailer loyalty programs, and visual merchandising to maximize secondary off\-take.
* **Depot \& Logistics Coordination:** 
 Work closely with the regional C\&F depot and logistics teams to forecast SKU demand accurately, ensure timely order dispatch, and avoid stock\-outs.
* **Market Intelligence:** 
 Monitor competitor movements, pricing changes, trade scheme dynamics, and product performance across the Kerala market to provide strategic feedback to corporate leadership.



  





**Candidate Profile** 



* **Core Industry Experience:** 
 12–15 years of hands\-on channel sales experience strictly within
 **Ceiling Fans, Home Appliances (SDA), or Consumer Durables** 
 .
* **Preferred Companies:** 
 Prior work experience with leading brands such as
 **Havells, Orient, Crompton, Bajaj Electricals, or Sujata** 
 will be strongly preferred.
* **Territory Network:** 
 Strong, active trade relationships with electrical, lighting, and appliance distributors/dealers across
 **North Kerala** 
 .
* **Commercial Acumen:** 
 Strong grasp of trade pricing structures, channel margins, scheme economics, and credit risk control.
* **Leadership Capabilities:** 
 Proven track record of managing, motivating, and driving targets through multi\-tiered field sales teams.
* **Language Proficiency:** 
 Fluency in
 **Malayalam** 
 and
 **English** 
 is mandatory; working knowledge of Hindi is an added plus.
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; an MBA/PGDM in Sales \& Marketing is preferred.
